The '''SW-4''' was a dual [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] manufactured by [[ArMek/Legends|ArMek]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was most commonly used aboard [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

[[File:SW4ionCannon.jpg|thumb|left|180px]]

The SW-4 ion cannon was a notoriously delicate weapon system, and its internal crystal matrices invariably vibrated out of alignment during flight or combat. Rebel mechanics came to dislike the SW-4 due to the time they were forced to put in to maintain the cannons. At the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], only two of the Alliance's Y-wing fighters had functional ion cannons.

The BTL-S3 Y-wing variant had space for a weapons systems officer, who manually operated the SW-4 turret when necessary. Single-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] variants had their cannons locked forwards for optimum covering fire, though some pilots chose to lock it facing aft to counter pursuers.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' these cannons are replaced with [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]], this is probably for game balancing.
